name: Koromogae Maya
source:
She is a perfect girl who can cook, study, play sports, and do anything else.

She works part-time with her best friend Momona at Triton, a beach house. She is a kind and considerate girl at heart, although she often puts on airs due to her competitive nature.

Since she is Daisuke's childhood friend, she calls him Onii-chan.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=220493&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
